g.text: A verifiable requirement on the ACC system
The ACC system shall allow the driver to
select a set speed from 30 km/h to 160 km/h.
While no vehicle is ahead and the road is
level, the ACC system shall keep the vehicle
speed within 2 km/h of the set speed.
The ACC system shall activate only when the
vehicle speed is at least 30 km/h and no
The ACC system shall offer at least 3
selectable time gaps between 1.0 s and 2.2
While following a vehicle that drives at
constant speed, the ACC system shall hold
the selected time gap within 0.2 s.
The ACC system shall not request a vehicle

While the driver presses the accelerator

The ACC system shall display the current
ACC state, the set speed and the selected
When the deceleration needed to keep the
time gap exceeds 3.5 m/s², the ACC system
shall give the driver a visual and acoustic
When the radar sensor reports a fault or
blockage, the ACC system shall switch to the
fault state and inform the driver within 500
